description:
[read-only] Impressions, clicks, spend, link clicks and leads per campaign for a date range (default the last 30 days, at most 93), with totals per currency. Pass `level: "ad"` for daily per-ad results summed per ad (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, video views), each with the Library `contentId` the ad was built from (null when unlinked; `unlinked` counts those).
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/insights.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.
